lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly horizontal rows along the lateral midsection, posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of slightly higher pixel intensity intersecting with spot centroids, creating a matrix-like appearance on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge with a sharp luminance gradient, characterized by a lighter top edge and darker shadow beneath, extending from the dorsal region towards the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low density of small, discrete high-luminance blobs distributed primarily across the lower and middle sections of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregularity or small notch visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, distinct white spots on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
